cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base.note: The base trace tree: every column a segment commits that is not a lookup numerator and not preprocessed. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c4096.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.intera.note: The interaction tree: the LogUp numerator and denominator columns of every gadget in the segment. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c4096.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.bounda.note: The boundary trees, which commit the residual stream and the keys and values a segment hands to the segment that reads it. The chunk's cells object does not name them: they are what fresh has above base and interaction, which is how the audit reads them. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c4096.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.model.note: The model tree, one of the two preprocessed trees: the weights the segment reads. It is preprocessed and is therefore not part of fresh. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c4096.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.shape.note: The shape tree, the other preprocessed tree: the lookup tables and the constants the segment's shape fixes. It is preprocessed and is therefore not part of fresh. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c4096.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_a.note: The base trace's share belonging to the attention output's dequantization, folded straight to int8 because the requantize seam after it quantizes it again. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_d.note: The base trace's share belonging to the dequantization after each matmul, the bf16 chain and the power-of-two scales together. The chunk's `mats` list is this same count split per matmul and is not a component beside it. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_e.note: The base trace's share belonging to the embedding lookup that binds a block's first residual stream to the ids the statement publishes. Only a layer-0 segment states it, one per token block, and the chunk reports no embedding object on the others; it is 12,304 cells a position at both contexts because a block embeds its own 512 positions and no prefix. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_f.note: The base trace's share belonging to the weight matmuls, checked by Freivalds' method: the check's own accumulator columns, not the weights, which are preprocessed and are cells_per_position.headline.c4096.model. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_k.note: The base trace's share belonging to the attention scores over the key tiles, the diagonal block among them. It is the one component that grows with the prefix a block reads, which is why the two contexts are not the same shape. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_q.note: The base trace's share belonging to the quantization of q and k. It is 1,146,880 cells a position at both contexts: a layer quantizes its own 512 positions and the two output head segments state none. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_r.note: The base trace's share belonging to the requantization at the qkv, gateup and down seams, and to the multiplicity columns of the tables those seams look in, which the chunk reports beside the seams as `requant_tables`. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the two normalisations, the residual adds and the rope reconstructions. The chunk's `residual_stream_components` list is this same count split per component and is not a component beside it. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base_t.note: The base trace's share belonging to the LogUp tables: the multiplicity column each of them commits, over the exponential, the reciprocal, the range checks and the residual stream's own tables. The chunk gives every table its row count and its key columns and no cell count, so the audit charges one column of its rows; what fixes the column at one is that the components then close to the segment's own base tree exactly, on every segment that states no argmax. The interaction side of the same tables is four columns and is cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction_table. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.unattr.note: The base trace's cells no counter names: 131,727,360 on each of the two output head segments, none on any of the 288 layer segments, and the same integer at both contexts because a head segment reads its block's own positions and no prefix. It is the argmax gadget's base side, which proves the emitted token is the lowest-indexed maximum of the logits: the chunk's `interaction_split` prices the same gadget's interaction side at 1,012 columns over 131,072 rows and this is 1,005 columns over the same rows, one value short of two cells per comparison on either side. `family_cells` emits a bare integer for every other component of the base trace and none for the argmax, so the audit records the cells rather than attributing them. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096; it is not the 8,388,608-cell gap between a segment's fresh and its base and interaction trees, which is the boundary trees and is cells_per_position.headline.c4096.boundary.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.intera.note: The interaction tree's share belonging to the output head's argmax gadget, which proves which token the logits make the largest, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the attention output's quantization gadget, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the dequantization after each matmul, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the embedding lookup that binds a block's first residual stream to the ids the statement publishes, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the weight matmuls, checked by Freivalds' method, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the columns that carry a GKR reduction's claim into the AIR that consumes it, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the attention scores over the key tiles, the diagonal block among them, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the quantization of q and k, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the requantization at the qkv, gateup and down seams, and its tables, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the two normalisations, the residual adds and the rope reconstructions, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the LogUp tables themselves: the exponential, the range checks, the reciprocal and the residual stream's own tables, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c4096. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c4096.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

cells_per_position.headline.c4096.fresh_.note: The fresh cells of the 32 layer segments of one token block over the 512 positions that block proves: 44,557,347,792 cells over 512, block B8, the one block of the sequence whose prefix is the whole context. It is what the cost model's registration compares its layers-only prediction per decoded token against, and the block is the comparison the prediction means: the model prices 32 layers at the full context, where the earlier blocks of the sequence read a shorter prefix and cost less. The output head segment is not in it; layer segment B8L0 is, with the embedding lookup and the one extra cell an attention-output accumulator it carries, 41,168 cells a position between them. The same 32 segments proved again for the reduction ablation come to the same integer, `cells.ablation.c4096.all_five`. It is a larger figure than `cells_per_position.headline.c4096.base` and its two companions added up, which divide every segment of the run, output heads and short prefixes included, by every position the run proves.

Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c16384.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c16384.model.note: The model tree, one of the two preprocessed trees: the weights the segment reads. It is preprocessed and is therefore not part of fresh. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c16384.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c16384.shape.note: The shape tree, the other preprocessed tree: the lookup tables and the constants the segment's shape fixes. It is preprocessed and is therefore not part of fresh. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384; base, interaction and boundary add up to cells.headline.c16384.fresh and shape and model to the preprocessed cells beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base_.note: The base trace's share belonging to the attention output's dequantization, folded straight to int8 because the requantize seam after it quantizes it again. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the dequantization after each matmul, the bf16 chain and the power-of-two scales together. The chunk's `mats` list is this same count split per matmul and is not a component beside it. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the embedding lookup that binds a block's first residual stream to the ids the statement publishes. Only a layer-0 segment states it, one per token block, and the chunk reports no embedding object on the others; it is 12,304 cells a position at both contexts because a block embeds its own 512 positions and no prefix. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the weight matmuls, checked by Freivalds' method: the check's own accumulator columns, not the weights, which are preprocessed and are cells_per_position.headline.c16384.model. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the attention scores over the key tiles, the diagonal block among them. It is the one component that grows with the prefix a block reads, which is why the two contexts are not the same shape. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the quantization of q and k. It is 1,146,880 cells a position at both contexts: a layer quantizes its own 512 positions and the two output head segments state none. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the requantization at the qkv, gateup and down seams, and to the multiplicity columns of the tables those seams look in, which the chunk reports beside the seams as `requant_tables`. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the two normalisations, the residual adds and the rope reconstructions. The chunk's `residual_stream_components` list is this same count split per component and is not a component beside it. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

The base trace's share belonging to the LogUp tables: the multiplicity column each of them commits, over the exponential, the reciprocal, the range checks and the residual stream's own tables. The chunk gives every table its row count and its key columns and no cell count, so the audit charges one column of its rows; what fixes the column at one is that the components then close to the segment's own base tree exactly, on every segment that states no argmax. The interaction side of the same tables is four columns and is cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction_table. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The nine components and cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unattributed add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.base, and the interaction tree is split beside it.

cells_per_position.headline.c16384.unatt.note: The base trace's cells no counter names: 131,727,360 on each of the two output head segments, none on any of the 1056 layer segments, and the same integer at both contexts because a head segment reads its block's own positions and no prefix. It is the argmax gadget's base side, which proves the emitted token is the lowest-indexed maximum of the logits: the chunk's `interaction_split` prices the same gadget's interaction side at 1,012 columns over 131,072 rows and this is 1,005 columns over the same rows, one value short of two cells per comparison on either side. `family_cells` emits a bare integer for every other component of the base trace and none for the argmax, so the audit records the cells rather than attributing them. Added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384; it is not the 8,388,608-cell gap between a segment's fresh and its base and interaction trees, which is the boundary trees and is cells_per_position.headline.c16384.boundary.

cells_per_position.headline.c16384.inter.note: The interaction tree's share belonging to the output head's argmax gadget, which proves which token the logits make the largest, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the attention output's quantization gadget, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the weight matmuls, checked by Freivalds' method, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the columns that carry a GKR reduction's claim into the AIR that consumes it, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the attention scores over the key tiles, the diagonal block among them, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the quantization of q and k, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the requantization at the qkv, gateup and down seams, and its tables, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. The eleven components add up to cells_per_position.headline.c16384.interaction and the artifact splits no other tree this way.

The interaction tree's share belonging to the two normalisations, the residual adds and the rope reconstructions, added up over the run's slice outputs and divided by positions.headline.c16384. cells_per_position.headline.c16384.fresh.note: The fresh cells of the 32 layer segments of one token block over the 512 positions that block proves: 71,753,215,328 cells over 512, block B32, the one block of the sequence whose prefix is the whole context, on the same terms as the row at context 4,096: the output head segment is out, layer segment B32L0 is in with the embedding lookup and the one extra cell an attention-output accumulator it carries, and the earlier blocks of the sequence read a shorter prefix and are not in it. It is what the cost model's registration compares its layers-only prediction per decoded token against at this context.

e4.qwen2p5_14b.c4096.predicted_cells_per.note: The E4 prediction for Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct at context 4,096: fresh cells per decoded token over the model's 48 layer segments, layers only, at the statement tools/drivers/predict-14b.sh proves. Every segment is COUNTED from the prover's trace layout at the witness-calibrated fields of its own dump -- the master exponent table's size, the normalisation width and the attention output's five widths -- which are properties of the forward pass and exist before any proof of them does; runs/2026-09-11-register-14b-none/witness-fields.json holds them, one row per layer, and the registration names that file by digest. The 48 tables are 2^21 to 2^25 rows and not one size: a prediction that charges one, as the priced model does at the 8B's 2^23, is wrong by most of a table on the layers that are not 2^23, which is why this number moved from 151,193,309 when the owner ruled on 2026-09-11 that a model whose table size is known is priced at it. It is read out of runs/2026-09-11-register-14b-none/registration.json, whose prediction_sha256 is 406cf7e43961547cec58957ecd2042bc0085ae4d84efc6508810248ce4de3c37, and check.py re-reads that document on every run, because a registration is the one number here that must not move after it is made. No cell cost is charged on the committed side: nothing in this number is priced from a per-unit constant and no input comes from outside this repository and zk-prover. It was recorded before anything measured this shape, which is what makes it a prediction; the measured side and the ratio between them are not here yet, and are blocked on zk-prover #172 and #174.

e4.codellama_13b.c4096.layers.note: Layer segments proved, one process each, at S=512 against a 4,096-token prefix, spec b10-final, head groups 16,16,8, every binding gadget on and no skip flag. Layers 1 to 39 of 40: layer 0 is in no dump and in no proof, because the harness refuses to write it (its attention output's quotient term is 7 + 26 = 33 bits against the field's 31 in the widest form there is), so this is a 39-segment row and not the stack.

positions.predict13b.c4096.note: The decoded positions of the one token block this run proves, against a 4,096-token prefix. It is the divisor of that block's per-position rows and is not comparable with positions.headline.c4096, which counts a whole conversation's prompt and output over nine token blocks; this run proves one block, at 39 layer segments and no output head.

proof.predict13b.c4096.total_bytes.note: The serialized proofs of the run's 39 layer segments as the prover wrote them, added up: 3.28 GiB, one segment 83.0 to 89.1 MiB. Each layer output reports both sizes, `proof_bytes` for the proof structure the prover held and `proof_ser_bytes` for the document a verifier is given, and this is the sum of the serialized one; the in-memory sum beside it is 38.4 per cent of this, against 38.9 and 38.6 per cent in the two headline runs. The proofs of this run were made on the SIMD backend and the headline proofs on CUDA; a proof's size is the statement's and not the backend's, which runs/2026-09-08-reference-digest-plain-h100 shows by proving one segment on both to the same digest. Layers 1 to 39 of 40: layer 0 is in no dump and in no proof, because the harness refuses to write it (its attention output's quotient term is 7 + 26 = 33 bits against the field's 31 in the widest form there is), so this is a 39-segment row and not the stack.

proof.predict13b.c4096.bytes_per_segment.note: The median segment's serialized proof, over the run's 39: 86.1 MiB, against 83.0 MiB for the smallest and 89.1 MiB for the largest. Every one of the 39 reads the same 4,096-token prefix and proves the same 512 positions, so the spread here is the layer's own shape and nothing else; the headline sequence's segments spread over a factor of two and a half, and that is the prefix growing block by block. Layers 1 to 39 of 40: layer 0 is in no dump and in no proof, because the harness refuses to write it (its attention output's quotient term is 7 + 26 = 33 bits against the field's 31 in the widest form there is), so this is a 39-segment row and not the stack.

proof.predict13b.c4096.total_bytes / e4.codellama_13b.c4096.layers: what one layer segment of this shape cost in serialized bytes on average, 86.1 MiB. The median beside it is 0.09 per cent higher, because every segment of this run reads the same prefix; where the prefix grows block by block, as it does over a headline sequence, the two sit further apart. Layers 1 to 39 of 40: layer 0 is in no dump and in no proof, because the harness refuses to write it (its attention output's quotient term is 7 + 26 = 33 bits against the field's 31 in the widest form there is), so this is a 39-segment row and not the stack.

proof.predict13b.c4096.bytes_per_positio.note: proof.predict13b.c4096.total_bytes / positions.predict13b.c4096, which is 6.56 MiB: what 39 layer segments of this shape cost in serialized bytes per position of the block they prove. It is not the same figure as proof.headline.c4096.bytes_per_position, which is a whole sequence's 290 segments over nine token blocks whose prefixes run from nothing to the full context; dividing the two prices the prefix as if it were the model's width. Layers 1 to 39 of 40: layer 0 is in no dump and in no proof, because the harness refuses to write it (its attention output's quotient term is 7 + 26 = 33 bits against the field's 31 in the widest form there is), so this is a 39-segment row and not the stack.

proof.predict13b.c4096.bytes_per_segment.note: proof.predict13b.c4096.bytes_per_segment_mean / proof.headline.c4096.bytes_per_segment_mean_last_block: what one layer segment of the 13B shape costs in serialized bytes against one of the 8B shape, both at S=512, both against a 4,096-token prefix, both at the paper's five reductions and its quantization. It is what the two measured shapes say about proof size against model width, and it refutes both readings the post had. Charging proof bytes by parameter count predicts 1.4543, which is what the two models' parameters per layer divide to, and over-predicts this by 32 per cent. Charging them by segment count predicts 1.0000, because that reading holds a segment's proof fixed and multiplies by the layers, and under-predicts this by 10 per cent. Two points fix one number and not a curve, so no rule for a wider shape is recorded from them: at the 405B shape the two readings are a factor of 13 apart and this pair says only that the answer is neither of them.

mem.projected.c32768.peak_mib.note: The line through the two measured peaks, read at context 32,768: 0.4130859375 MiB a position of prefix, 72,031 MiB at context 0, 85,567 MiB here. 4,008 MiB above the card's 81,559, so one card does not hold it. The assumption is that the peak is linear in the context at S = 512 with the five reductions on, which two points cannot show. Measured since: runs/2026-09-13-memory-probe-c24576-h100 proved one decode segment at context 24,576 with --tight-table and the five reductions on. Layer 16, the shape almost every segment has, fits at 79,643 MiB (mem.probe.c24576.decode_peak_mib). Layer 0, the segment these lines are drawn through, does not: it ran the card out of memory with the card at 81,073 MiB of 81,559 (mem.probe.c24576.layer0_oom_peak_mib). So the line's verdict at 24,576 -- above the card -- is measured, and the row below it is not. And at 32,768 there is no such segment to weigh: the extraction refuses layer 0 of the last block by name, because the attention output's no-wrap window is 1 + 16 + 9 + 6 = 32 against the field's 31 (bits.probe.c24576.layer0_ao_no_wrap_margin is what was left of it one context down: nothing). So this row prices a statement the paper's quantization variant cannot form, on a card of any size.

mem.projected.c131072.peak_mib.note: The line through the two measured peaks, read at context 131,072: 0.4130859375 MiB a position of prefix, 72,031 MiB at context 0, 126,175 MiB here. 1.55 times the card's 81,559, and eight times the far measured context out from the pair the line is drawn through. The assumption is that the peak is linear in the context at S = 512 with the five reductions on, which two points cannot show. Measured since: runs/2026-09-13-memory-probe-c24576-h100 proved one decode segment at context 24,576 with --tight-table and the five reductions on. Layer 16, the shape almost every segment has, fits at 79,643 MiB (mem.probe.c24576.decode_peak_mib). Layer 0, the segment these lines are drawn through, does not: it ran the card out of memory with the card at 81,073 MiB of 81,559 (mem.probe.c24576.layer0_oom_peak_mib). So the line's verdict at 24,576 -- above the card -- is measured, and the row below it is not. The same refusal that stops 32,768 stops this: the attention output's no-wrap window gives out between 24,576 and 32,768, so no segment of this shape exists at 131,072 under the paper's quantization variant and this row prices one that cannot be written.

mem.projected.context_at_card_limit.note: Where the same line reaches the card's 81,559 MiB: a context of about 23,065, half again the larger of the two contexts it is drawn through and short of the 32,768 the row above prices. Projected and not derived: the arithmetic is three entries of this file, but the same linearity assumption carries it and two points cannot show that the line is straight. Measured since: layer 0 fits at context 16,384 (78,843 MiB, mem.probe.c16384.layer0_peak_mib) and does not fit at 24,576 (out of memory, mem.probe.c24576.layer0_oom_peak_mib), so the context this card gives out at is between those two, and the 23,065 this row projects is inside that range. The range is what is measured; the number inside it is still the line's. It is also not the only limit, and above 24,576 it stops being the binding one: the statement's own attention output no-wrap window gives out between 24,576 and 32,768 (bits.probe.c24576.layer0_ao_no_wrap_margin), and that is a limit on the statement and not on the card.

moe.routing.qwen3_30b_a3b.c16384.s512.to.note: The busiest routed matmul of a block of 512 positions: the tokens the most-used expert of a mixture layer took, meaned over the 48 layers and the 1536 blocks. Under assumption.cost_model.moe_routing every routed matmul of this block covers 32 tokens (exact_cells.routed_blocks at E = 128, k = 8, S = 512); a measured block is laid out from its own histogram, which runs/<run>/routing.json carries in full. That flat figure is what the model BUILDS and not what a uniform draw's busiest expert takes, which is higher than the share for the same reason any multinomial maximum is: read this against the histogram, not against the share.

moe.routing.qwen3_30b_a3b.c16384.s1024.d.note: How many distinct experts a block of 1024 consecutive positions touches in one mixture layer of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B, measured on 1 prompt(s) of 16384 positions from the harness's eval corpus: the mean over the 48 mixture layers and the 16 block(s) each prompt divides into, 768 blocks in all, spread 46 to 119. This is the quantity assumption.cost_model.moe_routing assumes: the routed matmuls a segment builds, and so the weights its preprocessed trace holds.

What the assumption gives for the same block: E (1 - (1 - k/E)^S) at E = 128, k = 8, S = 1024, which is exact_cells.expected_distinct_experts. It is beside the measured entry so the two are read together and neither is a second measurement of the other.

segments.block.c4096.s256.note: The last token block of the context 4,096 plan at S = 256: block 16 of 17, its 32 layer segments, prefix 4,096 positions. No output head segment is in the plan, so this is the block's layer segments and nothing else.

cells.block.c4096.s256.fresh.note: Fresh committed cells over that block's 32 layer segments: 100.032 M per proved position, against 87.026 M for the same 32 segments of the same plan at S = 512 (runs/2026-09-09-headline-c4096-h100, block 8). A shorter block costs 15.0% more a position.

secs.block.c4096.s256.commit.note: At S = 256, the commitment path over the block's 32 segments. The same 32 segments at S = 512 took 21.244 s, 35.283 s, 704.342 s and 426.642 s at these four scopes, the last of them summed per segment because that block shared its process with others.

secs.block.c4096.s256.stwo_total.note: At S = 256, commit plus the prover's own call, over the same 32. The same 32 segments at S = 512 took 21.244 s, 35.283 s, 704.342 s and 426.642 s at these four scopes, the last of them summed per segment because that block shared its process with others.

secs.block.c4096.s256.whole_wall.note: At S = 256, trace, interaction, stwo and serialization, summed per segment over the same 32. The same 32 segments at S = 512 took 21.244 s, 35.283 s, 704.342 s and 426.642 s at these four scopes, the last of them summed per segment because that block shared its process with others.

secs.block.c4096.s256.loop.note: At S = 256, the one process the 32 segments were proved in, pipelined one segment ahead. The same 32 segments at S = 512 took 21.244 s, 35.283 s, 704.342 s and 426.642 s at these four scopes, the last of them summed per segment because that block shared its process with others.

mem.block.c4096.s256.peak_mib.note: The most the card reported holding at any moment of the loop, sampled once a second. The card has 81,559 MiB, so this block used 71.4% of it, against the 73,723 MiB the whole sequence at S = 512 peaked at. The prover's own high-water mark for the same loop is 61,097,181,184 bytes, which is this number to the MiB.

proof.block.c4096.s256.bytes_per_segment.note: The median segment's serialized proof over the block's 32, between 108,880,771 and 116,945,135: 106.9 MiB, against 78.0 MiB for the same 32 segments at S = 512. A halved block makes a larger proof per segment, and 2.74 times the bytes a proved position.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s256.commit.note: secs.block.c4096.s256.commit / segments.block.c4096.s256. The same average over the same 32 segments at S = 512 is 0.663869 s, 1.102591 s, 22.010692 s and 13.332570 s, the last two at whole wall and per-chunk loop.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s256.stwo_t.note: secs.block.c4096.s256.stwo_total / segments.block.c4096.s256. The same average over the same 32 segments at S = 512 is 0.663869 s, 1.102591 s, 22.010692 s and 13.332570 s, the last two at whole wall and per-chunk loop.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s256.whole_.note: secs.block.c4096.s256.whole_wall / segments.block.c4096.s256. The same average over the same 32 segments at S = 512 is 0.663869 s, 1.102591 s, 22.010692 s and 13.332570 s, the last two at whole wall and per-chunk loop.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s256.loop.note: secs.block.c4096.s256.loop / segments.block.c4096.s256. The same average over the same 32 segments at S = 512 is 0.663869 s, 1.102591 s, 22.010692 s and 13.332570 s, the last two at whole wall and per-chunk loop.

cells.block.c4096.s256.exact_predicted.note: The prover's trace layout counted at S = 256 over these very 32 segments, each at the witness-calibrated fields its own dump carries: exact_segments at seq = 256, which is what predict.py --cells exact counts a registration with, written before the loop ran. The fields file states each dump's own ao_rem_bits, which is not the shared pin the loop proved at, so this figure is below what the loop committed by the row set that difference makes: zk-prover #194, and cells.block.c4096.s256.rho is the size of it.

cells.block.c4096.s256.rho.note: cells.block.c4096.s256.fresh / cells.block.c4096.s256.exact_predicted. The count is 0.63% LOW, and the block length is not why: the fields file states each dump's own ao_rem_bits, 14 to 20 over the layers, while the plan proved every segment at the shared pin of 20, so the count charges a narrower range table than the prover built -- five cells a row, and layer 0 is exact because its own width is already the pin. zk-prover #194 has the per-layer arithmetic and the recount at the pin.

segments.block.c4096.s1024.note: Layer 16 of the last token block at S = 1,024 -- block 4 of 5, prefix 4,096 positions -- proved on its own, which is the segment lib/seq5-reference.py reads as the reference segment at a context. One segment and not a block, so this row is not the 32-segment figure the S = 256 and S = 512 rows are. A block of 1,024 positions was expected not to fit an 80 GB card, so the plan is the one segment that answers that most cheaply; it fit.

cells.block.c4096.s1024.fresh.note: Fresh committed cells of that one segment: 2.570 M a proved position, against 2.721 M for the same layer of the same plan's last block at S = 512 and 3.137 M at S = 256 (runs/2026-09-09-headline-c4096-h100 B8L16, runs/2026-09-13-block-length-c4096-s256-h100 B16L16). A longer block costs fewer cells a position, and this is 1.889 times the S = 512 segment for twice the positions.

secs.block.c4096.s1024.commit.note: At S = 1,024, the commitment path, for the one segment this run proves. The same layer at S = 512 took 0.652 s, 1.090 s, 21.176 s and 12.937 s at these four scopes, the last being that chunk's own share of its process.

secs.block.c4096.s1024.stwo_total.note: At S = 1,024, commit plus the prover's own call, for the one segment this run proves. The same layer at S = 512 took 0.652 s, 1.090 s, 21.176 s and 12.937 s at these four scopes, the last being that chunk's own share of its process.

secs.block.c4096.s1024.whole_wall.note: At S = 1,024, trace, interaction, stwo and serialization, for the one segment this run proves. The same layer at S = 512 took 0.652 s, 1.090 s, 21.176 s and 12.937 s at these four scopes, the last being that chunk's own share of its process.

secs.block.c4096.s1024.loop.note: At S = 1,024, the process the one segment was proved in, which also reads the witness and builds the layer, for the one segment this run proves. The same layer at S = 512 took 0.652 s, 1.090 s, 21.176 s and 12.937 s at these four scopes, the last being that chunk's own share of its process.

mem.block.c4096.s1024.peak_mib.note: The most the card reported holding at any moment, sampled once a second. The card has 81,559 MiB, so ONE segment at this block length used 88.0% of it and 9,820 MiB were left. It was expected not to fit. This is one segment and not a segment loop: the S = 256 and S = 512 peaks are loops of 32 and 64 segments, although the recorded probe at context 16,384 found the same peak with the pipeline off and on.

proof.block.c4096.s1024.bytes_per_segmen.note: The one segment's serialized proof, so the median is that segment: 66.6 MiB, against 79.0 MiB for the same layer at S = 512 and 105.7 MiB at S = 256. A longer block makes a smaller proof per segment and far smaller per position -- 68,227 bytes a position here against 161,773 at S = 512 and 432,898 at S = 256.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s1024.commi.note: secs.block.c4096.s1024.commit / segments.block.c4096.s1024, which is one segment, so it is that segment's own seconds. It is here so that the per-segment row can be read at all three block lengths.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s1024.stwo_.note: secs.block.c4096.s1024.stwo_total / segments.block.c4096.s1024, which is one segment, so it is that segment's own seconds. It is here so that the per-segment row can be read at all three block lengths.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s1024.whole.note: secs.block.c4096.s1024.whole_wall / segments.block.c4096.s1024, which is one segment, so it is that segment's own seconds. It is here so that the per-segment row can be read at all three block lengths.

secs_per_segment.block.c4096.s1024.loop.note: secs.block.c4096.s1024.loop / segments.block.c4096.s1024, which is one segment, so it is that segment's own seconds. It is here so that the per-segment row can be read at all three block lengths.

cells.block.c4096.s1024.exact_predicted.note: The prover's trace layout counted at S = 1,024 over the segment this run proves, at the witness-calibrated fields its dump carries: exact_segments at seq = 1024, written before the loop ran. Its dump's own ao_rem_bits is 15 and the plan proved at the pin of 20, so this is one range table short of what the loop committed; zk-prover #194.

cells.block.c4096.s1024.rho.note: cells.block.c4096.s1024.fresh / cells.block.c4096.s1024.exact_predicted. The count is 5,242,880 cells low, which is five cells times the 2^20 rows of the range table the pin of 20 builds and the dump's own width of 15 does not: the same zk-prover #194 the S = 256 row carries, at one segment instead of 31. Counted at the pin the same function gives the measured figure exactly.
